 Where In Korea Was Kim Ji-won's 'Doctor X: Mafia In White' Filmed?
 Where is Gu Seo University Hospital in real life? We break down the shooting locations of Kim Ji-won's K-drama 'Doctor X: Mafia in White'.
 By Esha Dasgupta 
 Published: Nov 15, 2026 12:51 PM IST 3 min read

 Filming locations of Doctor X: Mafia in White 
 Highlights
 The Gu Seo University Hospital is fictional, but the building isn’t. See where Doctor X: Mafia in White was really shot.
 Find out what else there is to see and do at these places.
 The South Korean medical noir drama, Doctor X: Mafia in White , has all the ingredients for a great watch. From powerful doctors who would rather have money than save the patients to a freelance surgeon who refuses to play by the rules, and a kind-hearted intern who is no less than a moral compass. If Doctor X: Mafia in White has had you glued to your screen, you’ve probably wondered where this gripping series was shot. Here’s everything we know about its filming locations.

 Doctor X: Mafia in White : Trailer, cast, and other details
 Doctor X: Mafia in White was released on Netflix on November 9, 2026. The drama is based on TV Asahi’s Doctor-X: Surgeon Michiko Daimon and is produced by Studio Dragon, Studio S, and HighZium Studio. It is directed by Lee Jung-rim. The cast includes Kim Ji-won as Gye Su-jeong, Kim Woo-seok as Park Tae-kyung, Jin Hee Lee as Jo Won-jin, Son Hyun-joo as Bu Seung-gwon, Lee Jung-eun as Jang Hui-suk, Kim Young-min as Do Yun-sik, Lee Sung-wook as Bae Heung-gon, and Choi Deok-moon as Yang Eung-gu.
 Advertisement 
 The 12-episode series follows Gye Su-jeong, a genius freelance surgeon who takes on impossible operations and corrupt senior medical practitioners at a university hospital. Surviving solely on her unmatched surgical skills, she refuses to bow to hospital politics and works to expose systemic injustice around her. How that pans out for her and her patients remains to be seen.
 Shooting locations of Doctor X: Mafia in White 
 Yangsan 
 View of Eden Valley, Yangsan, South Korea | Image credit: yeowatzup, CC BY 2.0 , via Wikimedia Commons 
 The drama’s main setting is the fictional Gu Seo University Southwest Hospital. In real life, one of the main shooting locations of Doctor X: Mafia in White ‘s is the Yangsan Pusan National University Hospital, which was used for filming all the in-hospital and surgery scenes for the series. Various interior medical sets, operating rooms, and conference rooms were constructed in Gyeonggi-do and Seoul urban districts, although the exact details have been kept under wraps.

 Things to do in and around Yangsan: There is plenty to see and do near Yangsan for people from all walks of life. Hikers can head into the Yeongnam Alps, whose ridge trails around Cheonseongsan open up wide mountain views. Families can spend a day at Tongdo Fantasia, the city’s best-known theme park, while golfing enthusiasts can enjoy a game or two at Eden Valley, a country club with resort facilities set in the hills. For foodies, trying the Eonyang-style bulgogi is a must. Yangsan sits between Busan and Gyeongju, with the beaches and markets of Busan no more than an hour away, so if you have the time, plan for a quick trip to Busan as well.
 How to reach: Gimhae International Airport is approximately 24 kilometres away.

 FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions) 
 Where was 'Doctor X: Mafia in White' filmed?
 The main hospital scenes of 'Doctor X: Mafia in White' were filmed at Yangsan Pusan National University Hospital in South Gyeongsang Province. 
 Is Gu Seo University Hospital a real place? 
 No. It is a fictional hospital. The building that stands in for it is Yangsan Pusan National University Hospital.
 Who is in the cast of 'Doctor X: Mafia in White'?
 The cast of 'Doctor X: Mafia in White' includes Kim Ji-won as Gye Su-jeong, Kim Woo-seok as Park Tae-kyung, Jin Hee Lee as Jo Won-jin, and Son Hyun-joo as Bu Seung-gwon among others. 
 When was 'Doctor X: Mafia in White' filmed, and where can I watch it?
 Filming ran from December 4, 2025, to July 13, 2026. The 12-episode series airs on SBS on Fridays and Saturdays and streams globally on Netflix.
